bridge.title: Four things I noticed

beats.title: A free circle, a waitlist, and nothing in between.
beats.text: You have 11,500 Instagram followers, a podcast and a newsletter of more than 10,000. People join the free Money Circle, and the next step is a £27 course or a waitlist, because Wealth Resonance is closed right now.

beats.title: Your content speaks to women who already have a plan.
beats.text: “Why knowing you're financially safe doesn't make you feel safe”, “You can have 6 figures in the bank and still not feel safe.” That's the woman who'd invest in Wealth Resonance, and she's listening every week.

beats.title: Your best offers only sell in launch windows.
beats.text: Wealth Resonance is on a waitlist and the coach cohort opens in November. Between launches, the only way to work with you is a prepaid £495 session, booked without a conversation first.

beats.title: “I don't want to sell on calls.” It's a conversation about safety.
beats.text: An application and a short call let her feel seen before she invests, which is the whole point of your work. You only talk to women who've already said they're ready.
beats.quote: “People don't change just because we tell them what to do. They change when they feel safe.”

bridge.closing: So instead of explaining it, I built it. The page, the application, the emails and the ads, all below.

cards.title: You have a plan, and still feel anxious
cards.body: The budget, the savings pots, the spreadsheet. The worry hasn't gone anywhere.

cards.title: Strict one week, avoiding it the next
cards.body: You swing between controlling every pound and not wanting to look at all.

cards.title: The same money loop, again
cards.body: You know what you should do. Something older keeps pulling you back.

mechanism.title: It's not about the money. It never was.
mechanism.body: Wealth Resonance works where budgets don't reach: the beliefs and body responses you inherited about money. With Catherine, a former financial adviser turned trauma-informed financial coach, you learn to feel safe with money, so the decisions you already know how to make finally stick.

pillars.title: Your money story
pillars.body: Find the belief that keeps running the show.

pillars.title: Safety in the body
pillars.body: Somatic tools for the moments money feels threatening.

pillars.title: Confident decisions
pillars.body: Make money choices from calm, not panic.

pillars.title: Worth and wealth
pillars.body: Charge, earn and receive what you're worth.

items.title: Recordings and workbooks

steps.title: Book a call
steps.body: If it looks like a fit, pick a time to talk with Catherine's team.

steps.title: Decide on the call
steps.body: We look at where you are and whether it makes sense. The investment is explained on the call. No pressure either way.

notFit.title: Thank you for being honest.
notFit.body: Wealth Resonance isn't the right next step for you right now. Join the free Money Circle and the podcast, and apply again when the timing is right.

finalCta.title: Ready to feel safe with money?
finalCta.body: Apply here. One application, one gentle conversation, a clear answer.
finalCta.disclaimer: Coaching and education only. Nothing here is financial advice, and this service is not regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority. It is not therapy. Results depend on your own situation and are not guaranteed.

preCallEmails.subject: You're booked: here's what happens next
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is booked for {{call_time}}. The link is in your calendar invite.

Before we talk:
1. Keep the time free.
2. Think of one recent money moment that made you anxious, and bring it to the call.

One note: nobody on my team will ever ask you to pay through a DM. Payments only happen through the official links from this email address.

Talk soon,
Catherine

preCallEmails.subject: Knowing isn't the same as feeling safe
preCallEmails.previewText: Why a plan beats one more tip
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Most women I work with already know what they should do with money. The gap is that their body doesn't feel safe doing it.

That's where Wealth Resonance starts.

On the call we'll look at where you are today.

Catherine

preCallEmails.subject: "I've done budgeting courses before"
preCallEmails.previewText: Then this is the next step
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

So have most of the women in the programme.

Budgets work on the numbers. Wealth Resonance works on the reason the numbers keep slipping.

If you're not sure you need it, ask on the call. We'll tell you honestly.

Catherine

preCallEmails.subject: What we'll cover on the call
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

The call takes about 30 minutes:

1. Where you are now and what you've tried.
2. Where you want to be in a year.
3. How the program works, what it costs, and whether it fits you.

If it isn't a fit, we'll tell you. No pressure either way.

Catherine

preCallEmails.subject: Tomorrow: your call with Catherine's team
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Quick reminder: your call is tomorrow at {{call_time}}.

If the time doesn't work anymore, reschedule with the link in your invite so someone else can take the slot.

See you tomorrow,
Catherine

preCallEmails.subject: Today's the day
preCallEmails.body:
Hey {{first_name}},

Your call is today at {{call_time}}. Find a quiet spot and have your questions ready.

Talk soon,
Catherine
